parishes.name: Blessed Sacrament Church
notes: On public holidays, only the 8:30 AM weekday Mass is celebrated (no 12:30 PM or 6:30 PM Masses).
The 4:30 AM Saturday Mass is part of the 1st Friday vigil (Saturday morning).
The 3:15 PM Sunday Mass is Tagalog except on the 3rd Sunday, when it is in English.

parishes.name: Cathedral of the Good Shepherd
notes: No weekday Mass on public holidays.
Reconciliation available 15 min before weekend Mass when priests are available.

parishes.name: Church of Christ the King
notes: Confessions are available half an hour before all weekend Masses.
Nightly Rosary is on Zoom and not held on Tuesdays.
Church gates close at 12:00 noon.

parishes.name: Church of Divine Mercy
notes: On public holidays, weekday Masses are replaced by an 8am Mass only.
Sunday 11:30am Mass may exceed an hour due to attendance, baptisms, events, or solemnities.
Tagalog Mass is every 3rd Saturday at 7:30pm.

parishes.name: Church of Our Lady Queen of Peace
Church of Our Lady Star of the Sea
Church of Our Lady of Lourdes
notes: Sacrament of Reconciliation is available 15 mins before weekend Masses.
On public holidays (Mon-Fri), Parish Office is closed and main entrance gates close at 5pm.
Adoration Room is open 8am-8pm.

parishes.name: Church of Our Lady of Perpetual Succour
notes: On weekday public holidays, only 8:00am Mass.

parishes.name: Church of St Alphonsus (Novena Church)
notes: Confession available 30 minutes before Mass.
No booking required; no standing allowed in the main church hall due to fire regulation.

parishes.name: Church of St Anthony
notes: No 6.30 PM weekday Mass on public holidays; 7.30 AM public holiday Mass instead.
No devotions on public holidays that fall on weekdays except Days of Obligation.
Malayalam/Tamil/Tagalog Saturday evening Masses are on the eve of the 1st/2nd/4th Sunday; refer to bulletin for dates.

parishes.name: Church of St Bernadette
notes: Saturday 6:00pm Mass is a Vigil Mass.
Reconciliation is available 30 minutes before weekend Masses, excluding Sat 7:00am Mass.
Mass times may change during feast days, solemnities or other special celebrations; check News & Events.

parishes.name: Church of St Francis Xavier
notes: Reconciliation is strictly by appointment only.
Adoration is closed on public holidays.

parishes.name: Church of St Francis of Assisi
notes: No evening Mass on public holidays.
Weekend Confession starts 15 minutes before Mass.

parishes.name: Church of St Ignatius
notes: Confessions are 30 min before Friday evening Mass and before every weekend Mass (they end 5 min before Mass starts).
Divine Mercy Devotion every Wednesday after the 6pm Mass; Rosary Mon-Sat after the 7.30am Mass (no fixed start time).
All Masses are in English.

parishes.name: Church of St Mary of the Angels
notes: All Masses and Services are held in the Main Church, Level 1, unless otherwise indicated.
All Masses are in English unless otherwise indicated.
No weekday confessions; weekend confessions are 30 minutes before English Masses until 10 minutes before Mass begins.

parishes.name: Church of St Michael
notes: Public holidays on weekdays: only 7.30am Mass; no 6.30am or 6pm Mass.
Public holidays on Saturdays follow regular Saturday Mass times; public holidays on Sundays use weekend Mass times and are observed on the following Monday.
Liturgy of the Hours is on Zoom; register with csm.secretariat@catholic.org.sg.

parishes.name: Church of St Stephen
notes: On public holidays, weekday Mass is at 7.30am.
Eve/Day of Obligation if a weekday: 6.30am & 7pm.
All Masses are in English unless stated otherwise.

parishes.name: Church of St Teresa
notes: Reconciliation is 15 minutes before all weekend Masses.
Holy Hour is on the first Friday of the month at 20:00.

parishes.name: Church of St Vincent de Paul
notes: Adoration is closed on public holidays.
Indonesian Mass is only on the 5th Sunday of the month.
Confession is 30 mins to 10 mins before all weekend Masses; Sunday Rosary is 30 minutes before Mass.

parishes.name: Church of Sts Peter and Paul
notes: On public holidays, weekday Mass is 08:00 (preceded by Morning Prayer 07:40); no evening Mass if the public holiday falls on a weekday.
No Devotions/Prayers on public holidays.
Confessions are 30 minutes before weekday evening and weekend Masses; not available Thursday evenings.

parishes.name: Church of the Holy Cross
notes: Saturday 6:00pm Mass is in Mandarin.

parishes.name: Church of the Holy Family
notes: Mass and services are held in the Main Church unless otherwise indicated.
Mass is in English unless otherwise indicated.
Confessions are heard 30 minutes before each weekend Mass.

parishes.name: Church of the Immaculate Heart of Mary
notes: Walk-in Confession Mon & Tue 9-11am except public holidays.
Vietnamese Mass at IHM ended 17 Nov 2024; contact Church of the Sacred Heart for Vietnamese Mass timings.
Main Church Reconciliation is 30 min before Mass; weekday Rosary Devotion is 40 min before Mass.

parishes.name: Church of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
Church of the Risen Christ
notes: No regular weekday Mass times on public holidays; see public holiday Masses.

parishes.name: Church of the Sacred Heart
notes: Masses are in English unless otherwise stated.
Public holiday Mass at 8am in the Chapel.
Confession is 30 minutes before Saturday Sunset and Sunday Masses.

parishes.name: Church of the Transfiguration
notes: Days of Obligation (weekdays): 6.30am & 8.00pm.
Eucharistic Healing: first Thursdays, 8.00pm; if it falls on a public holiday, held on the following Thursday.

parishes.name: St Anne's Church
notes: Confessions are heard 20 minutes before each weekend Mass in the Confessional Box at the back of the Main Church.
Adoration Room is open Monday to Saturday 7am-10pm and Sunday 7am-6pm; closed on Public Holidays and during the Easter Triduum.
Mandarin Mass is on the first and third Sundays; Tamil Mass is on the fourth Sunday.

parishes.name: St Joseph's Church (Bukit Timah)
notes: Confessions are 15 minutes before all weekend Masses in the open foyer of the main Church.
No 6:30pm Mass in the Chapel of St Joseph on First Wed and First Fri; see regular entries for replacement times.
On Sun 4 Oct 2026, evening Mass is at 6:00pm instead of 5:30pm, followed by Candlelight Procession at 7:00pm.

parishes.name: St Joseph's Church (Victoria Street)
notes: Confession also daily 45 mins before Mass and 30 mins before Spanish Mass.
Public holiday Mass at 10:00am.
